purpose: Remove only unsupported or non-contributory complexity while preserving all necessary multi-stage, branching, corroborative, and independently valuable routes.

local_math_modeling_skills.policy: Do not read, invoke, cite, or rely on any locally installed mathematical-modeling skill when training or revising this model.

route_count_policy.removal_basis: no trigger, duplicated function without corroboration value, insufficient data capacity, unfair comparison, no independent gain, or no effect on required conclusions

anti_peeking: Pre-register candidate roles and primary comparison; keep model selection inside nested or blocked validation; final evaluation data is consumed after one use.
claim: Operational rule-engine revision only; does not represent weight training, completed numerical solving, or an award guarantee.
